title: Ladakh Police remove Sonam Wangchuk from protest site amid election curbs

ai.summary: Ladakh police removed climate activist Sonam Wangchuk from his protest site in Leh under election-related prohibitory orders, as he appealed to national leaders to intervene over slow judicial inquiry and concerns about winter polling.

facts.claim: Ladakh Police removed Sonam Wangchuk from his Leh protest site under election-related prohibitory orders
facts.quote: Ladakh Police removed Sonam Wangchuk from his Leh protest site under election-related prohibitory orders

facts.claim: Police said the preventive action was taken in compliance with orders issued by the Chief Electoral Officer of the Union Territory of Ladakh and the District Magistrate, Leh
facts.quote: the police said the preventive action was taken in compliance with orders issued by the Chief Electoral Officer of the Union Territory of Ladakh and the District Magistrate, Leh

facts.claim: Wangchuk posted a video message on X appealing to President Droupadi Murmu, Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah, Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi and the people of India to intervene
facts.quote: Following the police action, Wangchuk posted a video message on X, appealing to President Droupadi Murmu, Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah, Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi and the people of India to intervene in the situation in Ladakh

facts.claim: Wangchuk alleged that the judicial inquiry into the September 24 incidents in Leh was progressing slowly, more than a year after the events
facts.quote: Wangchuk alleged that the judicial inquiry into the September 24 incidents in Leh was progressing slowly, more than a year after the events

facts.claim: Wangchuk claimed that talks on restoring democracy in the Union Territory had broken down
facts.quote: Wangchuk claimed that talks on restoring democracy in the Union Territory had broken down

facts.claim: Wangchuk questioned the timing and conduct of the upcoming council elections
facts.quote: Questioning the timing and conduct of the upcoming council elections, Wangchuk alleged that the administration was pushing ahead with the polls to install people of its choice to negotiate on issues concerning democracy and safeguards for Ladakh

facts.claim: Wangchuk raised concerns over the proposed election schedule, pointing out that December and January are the coldest and snowiest months in the region, with temperatures falling below minus 30 degrees Celsius in several places
facts.quote: Wangchuk raised concerns over the proposed election schedule, pointing out that December and January are the coldest and snowiest months in the region, with temperatures falling below minus 30 degrees Celsius in several places

facts.claim: Wangchuk said nearly half the population migrates out of Ladakh during this period for education, holidays and pilgrimage
facts.quote: He claimed that nearly half the population migrates out of Ladakh during this period for education, holidays and pilgrimage
